intro.summary: A separate Rongmei Christian song collection for Christmas and the church festival season.
intro.description: This is the first digitized release of Ngai Luzaam. Four Christmas-season selections have been transcribed from the supplied PDF so far; the printed collection contains more songs, and the remaining entries still need transcription and review.

credits.compiledBy: Transcribed from the supplied Ngai Luzaam PDF; partial digital edition
credits.publisher: Original publication details not yet verified
credits.rights: Song text and source-book rights remain with their respective authors, translators, compilers, publishers, and rights holders. This digital transcription does not change ownership.

changelog.note: Added the Ngai Luzaam collection page and an initial four-song Christmas-season transcription. More songs remain to be digitized and checked.
